# Guanyi Yang: research library

> Economist at Colorado College. Research on labor markets, human capital, inequality, emerging economies, and environmental valuation.

The HTML paper pages, PDFs, and plain-text research notes below describe the same research. Publication status, version information, and scope are recorded on each page.

This is a companion research library. The main academic website remains https://sites.google.com/site/guanyiyangeconomics.

Research index: https://yangguanyi.github.io/research/

## Papers

- [Contingent Behavior Modeling for Dark Skies Valuation at Great Sand Dunes National Park](https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/dark-skies-great-sand-dunes/): A visitor survey and recreation-demand model value darker skies at Great Sand Dunes and develop personalized scenarios for environmental valuation. (American Journal of Agricultural Economics, 2026). Research note: https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/dark-skies-great-sand-dunes/llms.txt
- [Macroeconomics of Racial Disparities: Discrimination, Labor Market, and Wealth](https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/racial-disparities-hiring-discrimination/): A quantitative search model connects hiring discrimination to racial gaps in unemployment, wages and wealth. (Working paper, 2026). Research note: https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/racial-disparities-hiring-discrimination/llms.txt
- [Better Late Than Never: Macroeconomic Impact of Intermittent College Enrollment and Tuition Subsidies](https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/intermittent-college-enrollment/): A life-cycle model measures how the option to delay or return to college helps households invest in skills and respond to labor-market risk. (Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control, 2025). Research note: https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/intermittent-college-enrollment/llms.txt
- [Global Financial Risk, Equity Returns and Economic Activity in Emerging Countries](https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/global-financial-risk-equity-returns-emerging-markets/): A panel SVAR compares equity markets and borrowing spreads as channels for global financial-risk shocks in emerging economies. (Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics, 2024). Research note: https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/global-financial-risk-equity-returns-emerging-markets/llms.txt
- [Sibling Spillovers in Rural China: A Story of Sisters](https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/sibling-spillovers-rural-china/): School-entry eligibility identifies education spillovers from younger to older siblings in rural China, with the strongest evidence among younger sisters. (China Economic Review, 2022). Research note: https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/sibling-spillovers-rural-china/llms.txt
- [Unemployment Dynamics and Informality in Small Open Economies](https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/informality-unemployment-small-open-economies/): Cross-country evidence and a model of Mexico examine how informal employment buffers unemployment fluctuations. (European Economic Review, 2022). Research note: https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/informality-unemployment-small-open-economies/llms.txt
- [How Much Does Schooling Disutility Matter?](https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/schooling-disutility/): A theoretical analysis shows how the psychic cost of schooling changes the relationship between wealth, risk and education decisions. (Research in Economics, 2021). Research note: https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/schooling-disutility/llms.txt
- [Does Wealth Matter? An Assessment of China’s Rural-Urban Migration on the Education of Left-Behind Children](https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/left-behind-children-parental-migration-wealth/): A household model and rural Chinese data examine how wealth shapes the tradeoff between migrant parents' time and financial resources. (China Economic Review, 2020). Research note: https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/left-behind-children-parental-migration-wealth/llms.txt
- [Welfare Under Friction and Uncertainty: General Equilibrium Evaluation of Temporary Employment in the U.S.](https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/temporary-employment-us-welfare/): A model of heterogeneous firms measures how temporary contracts cushion the aggregate costs of firing restrictions and productivity risk. (Research in Economics, 2018). Research note: https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/temporary-employment-us-welfare/llms.txt
- [How Much Versus Who: Which Social Norms Information Is More Effective?](https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/social-norms-information-green-fee/): A randomized survey compares participation messages with fee-amount messages in a hypothetical campus environmental referendum. (Applied Economics, 2016). Research note: https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/social-norms-information-green-fee/llms.txt
- [The Effect of College Major on Labor Market Outcomes of Chinese Immigrants: An Examination of Undergraduate Major Choices and Their Impact on Employment and Earnings](https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/college-major-chinese-immigrants/): Historical ACS data describe college majors and their association with employment and annual earnings among Chinese immigrant men. (Journal of the Knowledge Economy, 2015). Research note: https://yangguanyi.github.io/papers/college-major-chinese-immigrants/llms.txt

## Research in progress

- Same Stimulus, Opposite Incidence: Monetary Policy, Fiscal Transfers, and Race in HANK. With EJ Ume. Draft forthcoming.
- Absorbing a College Supply Shock: Where Did the Adjustment Go?. With Xuan Jiang. Draft forthcoming.
- Artificial Night Light Exposure During Pregnancy and Infant Health. With Andrés Azqueta-Gavaldón and Ella Reese-Clauson. Draft forthcoming.
